scenes.title: Start
scenes.headline: Kawaii Portfolio Engine 🌸
scenes.subtitle: Built with love · Powered by friendship · Sparkle every deploy 💖

scenes.title: Dream
scenes.heading: The Cutest Renderer
paragraphs: This engine was powered by bows and built with friendship. Every scene sparkles with its own personality — no two JSON files need to look alike.
The kawaii architecture keeps things simple: one renderer, infinite cuteness. Swap the data file and the whole world changes color.

scenes.title: Create
scenes.heading: Small Joys, Big Impact
paragraphs: The smallest details make the biggest difference. A well-placed bow. A perfectly rounded corner. A gradient that fades like a sunset over candyland.
This hand-crafted approach means every presentation feels personal — because it is. No templates. No boilerplate. Just heart.

scenes.title: Credits
paragraphs: Built with love, vanilla JS, and the cutest CSS custom properties you have ever seen 💖
No frameworks. No build step. Just pure, sparkly code that runs anywhere the web does.
Life is too short for ugly presentations. Make everything a little bit cuter.
scenes.postscript: Be kind. Be kawaii. Be yourself 🌷

modal-bow.title: Bow Power 🎀
modal-bow.body: A bow makes everything better. This engine uses bows as watermarks, icons, and reminders that beauty lives in the details. A well-placed accent transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary.

modal-flower.title: Flower Friends 🌸
modal-flower.body: Flowers bloom wherever they are planted. In this system, every scene can grow its own personality. Swap the data file and watch a whole new garden appear — same soil, new flowers.

modal-joy.title: Small Joys ✨
modal-joy.body: The little things matter. A smooth animation. A color that makes you smile. A tooltip that says the right thing at the right time. This engine was built to celebrate small joys — one pixel at a time.

modal-craft.title: Hand-Crafted 🧵
modal-craft.body: No AI-generated templates here. Every scene is lovingly hand-crafted in JSON, rendered with care, and styled with intention. Because the best work is made by hand — even when it runs on code.
